capabilities: Keep markdown links rendered as their title text in Live Preview
Skip the cursor over hidden [text](url) syntax when arrowing between lines
Show a hover popup with the URL plus copy, open, and edit actions
Open an edit-link popup from the keyboard via an Edit link at cursor command
disambiguation: Despite the name, hovering is only a secondary way to open a URL popup; the main job is keeping links collapsed while typing and navigating.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents privacy behavior: no network requests, no stored data, clipboard writes only for the copy action.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that keeps markdown links collapsed to just their title text in Live Preview
motivation: The README's Problem section states the plugin exists because reordering or navigating lists of links causes constant expand/collapse flicker.
problem: In Live Preview, moving the cursor through a document expands markdown links to their raw form, causing disruptive expand/collapse flicker when navigating or reordering link-heavy notes.
summary: Live Preview plugin that keeps markdown links collapsed to their title text and reveals the raw [text](url) syntax only when the cursor sits inside the link.
